name: @hydronium-js/dom-client
description: Hydronium's browser client runtime: WASM Lua VM boot (wasmoon), DOM bridge, mount/hydrate, dev HMR client, JS-island bootstrap. Canonical source for what used to be hand-maintained directly under dom/src/hydronium_dom/client/ -- that tree is now a generated, drift-checked copy of this package's src/ (see ../../scripts/sync-dom-client.mjs and ../../scripts/check-dom-client-drift.mjs). Must keep working with NO bundler at all (a bare `<script type="module">`), which is why this package has exactly one runtime dependency and no build step of its own.
